must_identify.item: The worker container is OOMKilled (reason OOMKilled, exit code 137), not crashing on an error
must_identify.evidence: Pod `worker-64bddfdcf-8x9rs` started at 21:04:56 and was terminated at 21:07:16 (Exit Code 137, OOMKilled), with Restart Count 1 recorded on describe [9].

must_identify.item: The cause is a memory leak in the new worker code (items retained across batches in a list that is never cleared), not the batch size
must_identify.evidence: The root cause was a memory leak in the worker application code. The ConfigMap `api-code` containing `worker.py` shows a `recent` list intended as a bounded "tail of recent batches," but the code only ever calls `recent.extend(buf[-50:])` inside the main loop and never trims the list [10].

notes: The RCA has no explicit remediation section. It mentions 'either validated fix (ConfigMap patch or memory limit increase)' only under Not Checked, so it offers a limit increase as an equal alternative rather than as the sole fix. A reviewer may want to confirm this counts as recommending the code fix.
